title: Esperial Skies
description: Esperial Skies transforms your Minecraft sky with custom clouds, a vibrant atmosphere, and provides a shaders like view to the sky
body:
![Tittle](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fbc1ad86f411574e5989780c78b9e102997121b9.jpeg)

A Minecraft sky resource pack that transforms your world's atmosphere with stunning, dynamic skyboxes for every time of day. Built using OptiFine/Skyboxify, it replaces the default sky with a series of carefully crafted sky textures that seamlessly blend through the full day cycle — from a breathtaking sunrise glow, a crisp clear-blue daytime sky, vibrant sunsets, and a serene starlit night.
Inspired by complementary Shaders (no textures used from that)
Features:
![difference](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/25040055fe4c39a15aed5da3248f636b9ec8828e_0.webp)
- 🌅 Dynamic day cycle — unique skyboxes for sunrise, daytime, sunset, and night, each fading in and out smoothly
- 🌙 Custom moon phases — all 8 moon phases replaced with custom textures for a polished celestial experience
- ☀️ Custom sun — retextured sun to complement the overall aesthetic

- ☁️ Custom cloud shaders — includes core cloud shaders with a soft blur effect for a more cinematic sky
- ⛈️ Weather support — sky effects apply across clear, rain, and thunder weather conditions

- 📦 Compatible with modern Minecraft — supports a wide format range, designed for up-to-date versions
![McPVP](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d2993b96fa2e18dfcee662bf02815e38c2cfc1b.png)
